question: Does increasing insurgent recruitment tempo shorten organizational survival by accelerating recruitment-linked capital burn faster than the organization replenishes resources?
primary: time to canonical insurgent organization inactivity
collapse cause classified from pre-collapse deterministic conditions

classification.rooted_exhaustion: not applicable under fielded-continuity while operational force >= minimum formation personnel
classification.stochastic: no deterministic condition true immediately before organization-ecology event that deactivates organization

tests: Report survival curve over recruitment multipliers.
Test monotonic/non-monotonic relationship between recruitment multiplier and median collapse time without fitting a parametric law unless supported.
If higher recruitment lowers survival and collapse is predominantly capital-triggered, classify metabolic ceiling supported.
Compare cumulative recruitment gained per capital burned before collapse.
Do not use government policy ranking on this seed block.
guard: Synthetic mechanism confirmation only. Recruitment multiplier and internal capital are not empirical estimates.
